svg.aria-label: Dapaa (@dafayudaalpazri): Full-stack developer & digital product builder. Title card: an autofocus HUD hunts through floating cards (a sticky note reads "Too much attention can make a donkey think it's a lion."; a "Now playing" card spins 505 by Arctic Monkeys; a terminal, a notification, an elevator floor display), then locks onto the name inside a black hole's shadow. Data as of 2026-11-19: 6 public repos, 17 contributions in the last 12 months.
